name: Amyrina
message: 「Um, I went ahead and made today my birthday for now, but... does it happen to overlap with any special day?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Personally, I'm hoping it's just an ordinary day that doesn't stand out too much.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Oh, it's a play on words... I see.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Thank goodness... So today really is an ordinary, unremarkable day. What a relief.」
